workflow.title: Context Engineering Pipeline
workflow.description: Interactive multi-branch document validation flow with automated decision checks.

nodes.label: Context Engineering Pipeline
nodes.desc: BPMN Start Event: Trigger point of the pipeline.

nodes.label: 1. File Selection
nodes.desc: Select target source files in Codebase Explorer.

nodes.label: 2. Blast Radius
nodes.desc: Transitive BFS traversal computes callers & callees.

nodes.label: 3a. Minifier
nodes.desc: AST skeletonization strips method implementation bodies.

nodes.label: 3b. Raw Context
nodes.desc: Exports complete unminified source code context.

nodes.label: 4. Anonymizer
nodes.desc: Regex rules replace sensitive secrets & database URIs.

nodes.label: 5. Prompt Export
nodes.desc: Compiles structured XML prompt & copies payload to clipboard.

nodes.label: Pipeline Completed
nodes.desc: BPMN End Event: Context generated and ready.
